from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, tempfile, os
root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stress-validation-",dir=root/"target"))
print(f"validation record: {out / 'summary.json'}",flush=True)
def measured():
 inputs=[p for d in ('src','tests','examples') for p in (root/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
 inputs += sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md')) + sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.schema.json')) + [root/'README.md']
 inputs += [root/p for p in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo/mutants.toml','scripts/coverage.py','scripts/mutation_core.py')]
 return {str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(inputs)}
musl_cc=str(root/'target/http-musl-toolchain/root/usr/bin/musl-gcc')
record={'complete':False,'started':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':measured(),'musl_compiler':musl_cc,'checks':[]}
musl=['--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']
commands=[('gnu-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked']),('gnu-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release']),('musl-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked',*musl]),('musl-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release',*musl]),('clippy-gnu',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('clippy-musl',['cargo','clippy','--locked',*musl,'--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('format',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check']),('coverage-helper',['python3','tests/coverage_tools.py']),('mutation-helper',['python3','tests/mutation_tools.py'])]
try:
 for label,command in commands:
  print('running '+label,flush=True)
  log=out/(label+'.log')
  with log.open('w') as stream:
   result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=2400,env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='4',CC_x86_64_unknown_linux_musl=musl_cc))
  content=log.read_text()
  rows=re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',content)
  check={'label':label,'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'tests':dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored'),[sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)])),'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
  record['checks'].append(check)
  (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(check),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print(content[-12000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 record['inputs_unchanged']=measured()==record['input_sha256']
 record['complete']=record['inputs_unchanged']
finally:
 record['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('complete' if record['complete'] else 'INPUTS CHANGED', flush=True)

"""Run the stress test with 1,000 iterations in each GNU/musl debug/release profile."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
root = Path("/home/dhilipsiva/projects/dhilipsiva/botwork")
out = root / "target/stress-campaign"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
musl = ["--target", "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"]
profiles = [("gnu-debug", []), ("gnu-release", ["--release"]), ("musl-debug", musl), ("musl-release", ["--release", *musl])]
record = {"iterations": 1000, "runs": []}
env = dict(os.environ, CC_x86_64_unknown_linux_musl=str(root / "target/http-musl-toolchain/root/usr/bin/musl-gcc"), BOTWORK_STRESS_ITERATIONS="1000")
status = 0
for label, arguments in profiles:
    report = out / f"{label}.json"
    report.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    log = out / f"{label}.log"
    command = ["cargo", "test", "--locked", *arguments, "--test", "stress"]
    with log.open("w") as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=dict(env, BOTWORK_STRESS_REPORT=str(report)), timeout=7200)
    data = json.loads(report.read_text()) if report.exists() else None
    record["runs"].append({"label": label, "command": command, "status": result.returncode, "log": str(log.relative_to(root)), "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "report": str(report.relative_to(root)), "report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if report.exists() else None, "failures": data["failures"] if data else None})
    print(label, result.returncode, data["failures"] if data else "no report", flush=True)
    status |= result.returncode
(out / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
raise SystemExit(status)

"""Leak every 100th HTTP connection: 10 iterations pass, 1,000 catch it."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
root = Path("/home/dhilipsiva/projects/dhilipsiva/botwork")
out = root / "target/stress-campaign"
path = root / "src/core/eval/builtins/http/transport.rs"
original = path.read_text()
before = "    } else {\n        Box::new(stream)\n    };\n"
after = ("    } else {\n"
         "        static CALLS: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize = std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0);\n"
         "        if CALLS.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) % 100 == 99 {\n"
         "            Box::new(Box::leak(Box::new(stream)))\n"
         "        } else {\n"
         "            Box::new(stream)\n"
         "        }\n"
         "    };\n")
assert original.count(before) == 1
record = {"fault": "Leak the TCP stream of every 100th HTTP request in the process", "patch": {"file": str(path.relative_to(root)), "before": before, "after": after}, "runs": []}
try:
    path.write_text(original.replace(before, after))
    for iterations in (10, 1000):
        report = out / f"intermittent-{iterations}.json"
        report.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        command = ["cargo", "test", "--locked", "--release", "--test", "stress"]
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3600, env=dict(os.environ, BOTWORK_STRESS_ITERATIONS=str(iterations), BOTWORK_STRESS_REPORT=str(report)))
        data = json.loads(report.read_text())
        failures = [dict(scenario=s["scenario"], **f) for s in data["scenarios"] for f in s["failures"]]
        record["runs"].append({"iterations": iterations, "status": result.returncode, "report": str(report.relative_to(root)), "report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "failures": failures})
        print(iterations, result.returncode, failures, flush=True)
finally:
    path.write_text(original)
assert path.read_text() == original
(out / "intermittent-probe.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")

import json, pathlib, subprocess, os, sys
root = pathlib.Path("/home/dhilipsiva/projects/dhilipsiva/botwork")
S = pathlib.Path("/tmp/claude-1000/-home-dhilipsiva-projects-dhilipsiva-botwork/bf580eda-fba7-4d4c-8d68-f634c8c41a54/scratchpad")
data = json.loads((root / "tests/mutation-core.json").read_text())
for entry in data["mutations"]:
    if entry["area"] != "stress":
        continue
    path = root / entry["file"]
    original = path.read_text()
    report = S / f"stress-probe-{entry['id']}.json"
    try:
        path.write_text(original.replace(entry["before"], entry["after"], 1))
        result = subprocess.run(["cargo", "test", "--locked", "--test", "stress"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600,
                                env=dict(os.environ, BOTWORK_STRESS_REPORT=str(report)))
        errors = [l for l in result.stderr.splitlines() if l.startswith("error")][:3]
        classes = []
        if report.exists():
            r = json.loads(report.read_text())
            classes = [(s["scenario"], f["class"], f["iteration"], f["message"][:90]) for s in r["scenarios"] for f in s["failures"]]
        print(entry["id"], "exit", result.returncode, errors, classes, flush=True)
    finally:
        path.write_text(original)
